description: Verify that getFieldA / setFieldA(0xAA) / resetInterface / getFieldA — post-reset value differs
approach:
[Objective]
Reset semantics: resetInterface (Fire&Forget) clears field state — post-reset getter returns the default value, NOT the previously-set 0xAA.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT → Tester: OfferService.
2. getFieldA → response.
3. setFieldA(0xAA) → response.
4. resetInterface (Fire&Forget).
5. getFieldA → response (must NOT be 0xAA).

[Pass condition]
Observed DUT behaviour matches the spec property.

[Fail condition]
Per-phase Fail_phase<n>_* per the verdict list.

verdicts.Pass: DUT cleared field on reset — normal
